name: Colfax Marathon
summary: The Colfax Marathon is a city marathon in Denver. It starts and finishes in City Park and is a Boston Marathon qualifier. The route follows Colfax Avenue, Sloan's Lake and the Cherry Creek Trail, and runs through the Empower Field at Mile High stadium twice.
courseHighlights: Start and finish in City Park, beside Ferril Lake
Run through Denver Fire Station #1 near mile 6
Run through Empower Field at Mile High twice, near miles 6 and 20
Sloan's Lake and the Colfax Avenue stretch west toward Lakewood
Cherry Creek Trail and Confluence Park

paceStrategy.summary: The official course guide describes flat and fast middle miles, a downhill section around miles 16–20, and an uphill road out of downtown near the end. Start at an even effort and keep energy for the last 6 miles.

segments.terrain: Colfax Avenue, downtown and the Cherry Creek Trail
segments.advice: Hold goal pace or slightly slower while the crowds are thick.

segments.terrain: Short climb out of the stadium, then flat Colfax and Sloan's Lake
segments.advice: Ease up the short climb and settle back into goal pace on the flat road.

segments.terrain: West on Colfax, then Lakewood and The Glens
segments.advice: Stay relaxed and keep a steady effort.

segments.terrain: Downhill on Colfax from Lakewood back to Denver
segments.advice: Let the pace come down a little, but keep your stride short to protect your legs.

segments.terrain: Stadium, river path, 16th Street Mall, uphill on 17th Avenue, then City Park
segments.advice: Run by effort on the uphill part of 17th Avenue and save a push for City Park.

fuelingNotes: The race site lists water and Gatorade every 2 miles and Honey Stinger gels at miles 6 and 20. Plan your own gels around those points.
tips: Train for a start at about 5,280 feet (1,609 m) above sea level; the Capitol's 13th step is exactly one mile high
Practise steady downhill running for the Colfax section between miles 16 and 20
The course runs on the warning track inside Empower Field at Mile High at about miles 6 and 20, so expect a change of surface
Check the current course map each year, because the marathon and half marathon routes have changed before

faq.question: Is the Colfax Marathon course flat?
faq.answer: The official guide calls the Sloan's Lake section flat and fast, but it also lists a short climb out of the stadium, a downhill section from Lakewood and an uphill stretch on 17th Avenue. No elevation figures are published on the page we checked.

faq.question: Where do the Colfax Marathon start and finish?
faq.answer: Both are in Denver's City Park. The start is on the east side of Ferril Lake and the finish is between Ferril Lake and the Museum of Nature and Science.

faq.question: When is the Colfax Marathon held?
faq.answer: It is usually held in May, on a Sunday.
